row.body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says emerald flecks came from the orchard treatment; the horse kicked away its feed before the crossing was barricaded.
row.title: weathered bundle note — during the hot afternoon

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the emerald flecks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
